title: Learning to Deceive with Attention-Based Explanations

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models trained on occupation classification and gender identification tasks by manipulating attention weights to deliberately reduce focus on gender-indicating tokens (e.g., pronouns like 'he', 'she', or titles like 'Mr.', 'Ms.'). The paper then conducts human studies to determine if these manipulated attention maps successfully deceive participants into believing the model's predictions are not influenced by gender.
